title: State v. Nguyen
facts: Defendant and complainant were involved in a physical altercation at a bar
Defendant claims she acted in self-defense
jury_instructions: Consider whether the defendant reasonably believed force was necessary to prevent imminent harm.

evidence_items.content: Bartender testified the complainant struck first.
Medical report shows bruising on the defendant's forearm consistent with blocking blows.
A patron testified the defendant escalated the confrontation verbally beforehand.
